title.narrative: Enhancing social cohesion in Egypt through livelihoods and resilience building amongst the refugees, Sudanese newcomers, and host communities

description.narrative:
The overall objective of the project is to enhance socioeconomic stability and promote social cohesion in Egypt through building resilience and providing sustainable livelihood opportunities amongst the and Sudanese-refugee and Egyptian host communities. The expected outcome and outputs are as below:

·Outcome: Enhanced self-reliance of refugees and host communities through livelihoods support and social cohesion strengthening in low-income and underprivileged areas

·Outputs:

1.    Employability of refugee and Egyptian young women and men improved through vocational and skill building programmes.

2.    Increased access to decent jobs and entrepreneurship opportunities that meet labour market needs, while also facilitating linkages with the private sectors.

WFP is adopting a two-pronged approach to cover the diverse needs and profiles of the refugee and host community. This approach combines a) increasing employability of vulnerable groups to better access job opportunities vocational and skills building trainings, and b) facilitating access to income generating activities through entrepreneurship training and micro-grants for establishing MSMEs.
